journey.name: Mark Currently Playing Episode as Played
journey.description: Verifies that when a currently playing episode is marked as played, playback stops and the player reflects the completion.

actions.action: Verify that the app is on the Home screen and episodes are visible.
Tap the "Play" button on the first episode to start playback.
Verify that the mini-player bar at the bottom is visible and playing.
Tap the three-dots menu icon on the currently playing episode.
Verify that audio playback has stopped and the mini-player is no longer actively playing that episode.
